supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:58 UTC, WS-ICHEN-01 sent 51,000,389 bytes to the explicit proxy at 10.40.20.30:8080 over a connection lasting about 9 seconds; the connection recorded 9,017 bytes in the reverse direction.
The available record identifies the proxy as the network destination, but does not identify the external destination or the process responsible for the large transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-ICHEN-01 was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the alerted transfer; endpoint process and user attribution for that activity are therefore unavailable.
Proxy collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the transfer, so the proxy request, external host, URL, and any logged user attribution for it are unavailable.
Zeek connection telemetry was available, but the supplied record provides connection byte counts and proxy address rather than the content or ultimate destination of the proxied transfer.
claims_not_established: Whether the bytes were uploaded beyond the proxy or to which external service or destination.

additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy access, request, and tunnel logs for 13:45:58 UTC from any retained, replicated, or alternate source.
Obtain endpoint process, file, browser, and application telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 covering the transfer and surrounding period, including any locally retained logs from the collection outage.

unrelated_findings: After the alerted transfer, proxy records show ivy.chen browsing aws.amazon.com and requesting the AWS console in Chrome; these later requests do not establish the destination or purpose of the 13:45:58 transfer and should be reviewed separately if needed (T039-00266, T039-00267, T039-00286).
A Zscaler ZSATunnel process started on WS-ICHEN-01 at 14:12:33 UTC; this is outside the transfer time and does not establish a connection to the alerted activity (T039-00264).
